method: Filesystem-verified audit of G-node requirements against research/veyabench modules, tests/, web serving path, CI workflows, and artifacts/release evidence. Every classification was checked against actual files present at audit time.

nodes.name: Repository governance and system map
nodes.notes: System map and production scope contract exist with evidence-backed module classification and boundary definitions.

nodes.name: Production scope contract
nodes.notes: Machine-readable scope (veya-production-scope-v1) with supported/unsupported boundaries: languages, decision primitives, candidate-set caps.

nodes.name: Structured gap audit artifact
nodes.notes: This audit itself: machine-readable per-node classification with evidence paths.

nodes.name: Contamination / train-test overlap detection
nodes.notes: exact_overlap, n-gram Jaccard, fuzzy SequenceMatcher, and semantic-neighbor (cosine >= 0.92) checks with a contamination-report contract; dedicated test suite present.

nodes.name: Calibration reporting (ECE, Brier, reliability, risk-coverage)
nodes.notes: Per-slice ECE (15 bins), Brier with frozen temperature, reliability diagram, risk-coverage deciles, accepted-vs-deferred accuracy; core calibration machinery in veya/calibration.py with tests.

nodes.name: Selective prediction with epsilon guarantee and per-slice gates
nodes.notes: select_threshold with epsilon parameter and risk_ucb95 / supports_epsilon_claim fields; G1-G4 per-slice gates; Wilson-bound sample-size inversion reproducing protocol reference values.

nodes.name: Freeze record integrity (hash-pinned evaluation freezes)
nodes.notes: build/validate/hash over canonical sort_keys JSON (veya-freeze-record-v1); release manifest is hash-pinned (veya-release-manifest-v2).

nodes.name: Perturbation robustness suites (surface + paraphrase noise)
nodes.notes: S4 surface noise (typo, OCR, punctuation strip, abbreviation) and S5 paraphrase noise (polite/formal/casual/question) with stable SHA-256 determinism; label-preserving wrap verified.

nodes.name: Blind prospective verdict (P1-P6 pre-registered gates)
nodes.notes: All constituent gate/report modules exist and are tested, but a unified blind_verdict.py P1-P6 orchestrator is NOT present in research/veyabench/ and prospective blind evaluation data has not been collected. Blocked on prospective data collection; orchestrator composition remains to be built.

nodes.name: Contract validation and error handling at serving boundary
nodes.notes: Whitelisted request/response contracts with validation and standardized upstream error mapping; gateway and security regression tests cover the error paths.

nodes.name: Concurrency-safe model serialization
nodes.notes: _INFER_LOCK guards inference serialization in the serving path, but no dedicated concurrency test suite and no formal documentation of the locking contract. Needs stress tests and documented guarantees.

nodes.name: Latency/throughput runtime performance audit
nodes.notes: runtime_audit.json and per-request queue_delay_ms / http_503_count / error-rate / concurrency-inflection post-processing exist in run_release_eval.py, but no formal repeatable load test against production-level traffic profiles has been executed as a gated artifact.

nodes.name: Reliability: graceful shutdown, structured errors, integrity checks
nodes.notes: Hash validation and structured error responses exist; missing graceful shutdown handling, health-dependent failover, and documented restart/recovery semantics.

nodes.name: Transport security headers (CSP, HSTS, audit logging)
nodes.notes: Content-Security-Policy header is set and tested; HSTS and security-relevant audit logging are not yet present (slated for Task 22 hardening pass).

nodes.name: Supply-chain integrity (lock file, SBOM, pinned dependencies)
nodes.notes: Dependencies declared in pyproject.toml but no committed lock file, no SBOM, no vendored hash pinning. Slated for Task 16.

nodes.name: License and third-party inventory
nodes.notes: Top-level LICENSE exists but no per-dependency license inventory or compatibility review. Slated for Task 17.

nodes.name: Shadow-mode serving with structured telemetry
nodes.notes: VEYA_SHADOW_MODE opt-in flag adds shadow: true telemetry and X-Veya-Shadow response header; _safe_telemetry includes timestamp (UTC ISO 8601), confidence, max_probability, automation, config_hash. Known residual gap: max_probability not whitelisted in web/contracts.py result payload, so it can log null.

nodes.name: Statistical drift monitoring
nodes.notes: Time partitioning (ISO week/day), period stats, and drift triggers: risk breach via Wilson UCB95, coverage drop, distribution shift via KS test with Stephens correction (numpy-only), config mismatch.

nodes.name: Operational health endpoints (deep health, readiness, metrics)
nodes.notes: Only a basic /api/health path returning status ok with upstream timeout check. No readiness/liveness distinction, no deep health (model load state, calibration state), no metrics exposition endpoint.

nodes.name: Containerization and orchestration (Docker/K8s manifests)
nodes.notes: No Dockerfile, docker-compose, or Kubernetes manifests anywhere in the repository.

nodes.name: Live traffic shadow evaluation in production
nodes.notes: Shadow telemetry and drift-monitor tooling are ready and tested, but running a live shadow evaluation requires actual production traffic, which does not exist yet. Blocked on deployment/traffic.

nodes.name: CI/CD tiered quality gates
nodes.notes: Three workflows exist (ci, release, security) with ruff lint scoped to veya/ at line-length 120, but no tiered gate structure (e.g., required-vs-informational checks, per-node release gates tied to this audit).

nodes.name: Reproducible release metadata (deterministic build provenance)
nodes.notes: Hash-pinned release manifest exists, but no reproducible-build metadata beyond it: no deterministic build provenance, build environment capture, or verifiable rebuild reproduction. Marked MISSING pending Task 16-era supply-chain work.

nodes.name: Operator documentation and runbooks
nodes.notes: Developer-facing web README exists; no operator runbooks (incident response, rollback, redeploy, drift-alert triage).

nodes.name: Final production-readiness verdict matrix
nodes.notes: Depends on closure of all other G-nodes; final readiness matrix not yet produced. This gap_audit.json is its input.
